# BrightnessManager

> **File:** `services/system/BrightnessManager.qml` · **Docs:** see [docs/dev](../../README.md)

Screen brightness per monitor: a laptop panel through its sysfs backlight (written with brightnessctl, which goes through logind), an external monitor over DDC/CI (ddcutil, VCP 0x10). Monitors are found once at startup and again when the screens change; values are read then and when the OSD opens (`refresh`), never polled. Writes show at once and are coalesced per monitor, so held brightness keys don't queue slow DDC calls.

### Properties

- `displays` (var): { screenName: { kind: "backlight" | "ddc", device, bus, max, value } }, value 0-1.
- `step` (readonly real)
- `namesKey` (readonly string): The monitors with a controller, by name; a string, so it only notifies when one comes or goes (not on every value)
- `names` (readonly var)

### Signals

- `brightnessChanged(string name)`: A monitor's brightness was set through axiom (not found on a refresh)

### Functions

- `average(names)`: The mean brightness of these monitors (those with a controller), 0 with none
- `setMany(names, value, silent)`: Every one of these monitors to `value`
- `available(name)`
- `valueFor(name)`
- `set(name, value, silent)`: A silent set doesn't emit brightnessChanged, so the OSD stays shut
- `dim(fraction, relative)`: Idle dimming (hypridle, through IPC): every monitor down to `fraction` (darker ones stay), or with `relative` down by `fraction` of its own brightness, then back to what each was on undim()
- `undim()`
- `stepBy(name, delta)`
- `refresh(name)`: Reads the monitor's current value, for changes made outside axiom
- `detect()`
